title: Amazon Develops World Product Graph to Index Online Shopping
excerpt: Amazon is reportedly planning to build a vast data vault of every product sold online to keep shoppers on its platform.
body_html:
Amazon is reportedly working on an initiative called the World Product Graph, designed to index information on every item sold across the internet, including products that are not currently available on Amazon.

According to reports, the project aims to gather comprehensive data on online shopping items and make this information accessible directly through Amazon's platform. The primary goal of the system is to reduce the likelihood that customers will leave the site to search for products elsewhere.
